title: F-16 Upgraded Central Air Data Computer
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8251  AFSC PZABB
detail_text: The Air Force is issuing this repair sources sought announcement as part of a market research survey to determine if additional sources exist that could become qualified for repair and restoration of the F-16 Upgraded Central Air Data Computer. The contractor would be required to repair and restore the F-16 UCADC, but not like new cosmetically. Responses to this Notice shall consist of an initial white paper (not to exceed 3 pages) describing the offeror?s capabilities with regard to trouble shooting, testing and repairing the F-16 items.
